scripts.format: bun fmt --no-script "src/**/*.ts" "src/**/*.tsx" "src/**/*.css" astro.config.mjs package.json tsconfig.json components.json ".vscode/*.json" .prettier-astro.json README.md "docs/*.md" && bun run format:astro
scripts.format:check: bun fmt --no-script --check "src/**/*.ts" "src/**/*.tsx" "src/**/*.css" astro.config.mjs package.json tsconfig.json components.json ".vscode/*.json" .prettier-astro.json README.md "docs/*.md" && bun --bun prettier --config .prettier-astro.json --check "src/**/*.astro"
scripts.validate: bun run check && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun test && bun run build
